translation: Took place in posad Serock, 2[7/8] November 1890, 9 AM. Appeared personally Josek Rubinsztejn, smith, 36, and Icek Rubinsztejn, locksmith, 50, both residing in posad Serock, and declared that yesterday at 4 AM died Josek Makowski, baker, 71 years old, son of the late [Michel?] and Bejla, leaving behind his widowed wife [Chana?] nee [Sudeknica?]. Upon eyewitness certification of the death of Josek Makowski this act was read to the witnesses, signed by us and one witness, the second witness illiterate.
